text: Figure 3.58: Select Design Time Variant Task Definition Select Design Time Variant Package AUTOSAR Root::M2::Methodology::Methodology Library::System::T asks Brief Description Description Select a system variant at system design time. This could be done in different ways: • Replace a model, which contains the variation points contributing to this particular variant and all the possible settings/elements, by a model, which does no more contain these variation points and which contains only the particular settings/elements selected for this variant. • In order to document the selection for further process steps, it is also possible to keep the information about the selected variant and the variation points in the model by introducing a PredefinedVariant along with appropriate fixed settings of system constant values. In constrast to variant selection in later process steps, no code generation or compilation is involved at system design time, thus this task is just a transformation of one XML model into another one. This task can be applied to a complete system description, represented by a System Extract. Meth.bindingTime = SystemDesignTime Relation Type Related Element Mult.
